target.title: fix(clawrouter): sanitize attribution headers to ByteString
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where ClawRouter automatic agent/session attribution headers could include emoji or CJK characters. Fetch/`Headers` requires ByteString values, so Unicode ids throw `TypeError` before the model request is sent. A first sanitize pass that replaced every non-printable ASCII character with `_` also collapsed distinct Unicode ids onto the same audit value (for example `agent-😀` and `agent-🚀` both became `agent-_`).

## Why This Change Was Made

`sanitizeAttributionValue` now mirrors the collision-resistant request-id pattern:

- Already printable ASCII (`[\x20-\x7E]`) and `<= 256` chars pass through unchanged (non-global regex test so `/g` `lastIndex` cannot leak).
- Otherwise replace non-printable ASCII with `_`, append `~` + sha256 hex slice (`ATTRIBUTION_HASH_LENGTH = 16`), and truncate the safe prefix so the total stays `<= 256`.

Control-character rejection, trim/empty handling, and explicit operator headers are unchanged.

## User Impact

**Before:** Unicode `agentId`/`sessionId` attribution could crash request construction with a ByteString `TypeError`, or distinct Unicode ids could collide after `_` replacement.
**After:** Automatic attribution headers are always printable ASCII ByteString; distinct Unicode (and over-long) ids stay distinct via the hash suffix; CR/LF values are still omitted; length cap remains 256.

## Evidence

Branch: `codex/clawrouter-attribution-bytestring` | Base: `upstream/main` @ `a5c5e3b713e7c16225394196af2cb37413f6fe22` | Head: `133b6c104f6b` | Node: v24.18.0 — Windows

### Regression tests

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > attaches bounded attribution without overriding configured metadata
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > sanitizes Unicode agent and session attribution to printable ASCII ByteString
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > keeps distinct Unicode agent ids distinct after ByteString sanitize
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > omits unsafe attribution header values

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
```

- Unicode agent/session ids become printable ASCII with a `~` + 16-hex hash suffix.
- Two distinct emoji agent ids sanitize to different headers; both construct with `new Headers(...)`.
- Existing CR/LF omission and 256-length cap coverage remain (over-long printable ASCII also gets a hash suffix).

### Diff summary

```text
extensions/clawrouter/stream.ts       | collision-resistant ByteString attribution sanitize
extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts   | Unicode hash-suffix + distinct-id Headers regression
```

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** ClawRouter automatic agent/session attribution headers sanitize to printable ASCII ByteString without collapsing distinct Unicode ids, so `Headers` construction no longer throws and audit ids stay distinguishable.
**Environment tested:** Windows, Node v24.18.0, worktree `codex/clawrouter-attribution-bytestring` @ `133b6c104f6b`, focused vitest plus `node --import tsx` calling production `wrapClawRouterProviderStream` / sanitize path (no live ClawRouter credentials).
**Steps run after the patch:**

1. Run `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts --reporter=verbose` (11/11 pass).
2. Run a temporary `node --import tsx .tmp-proof-106454.ts` that imports production `wrapClawRouterProviderStream`, sanitizes `agent-😀` / `agent-🚀` / `agent-中文`, prints redacted distinct headers, and constructs `new Headers(...)`.
3. Confirm three distinct sanitized values and Headers success; delete the temp proof file (not committed).

**Evidence after fix:**

```text
# vitest
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > sanitizes Unicode agent and session attribution to printable ASCII ByteString
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > keeps distinct Unicode agent ids distinct after ByteString sanitize
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > omits unsafe attribution header values
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)

# node --import tsx production path
sanitized (redacted):
  agent-😀 -> agent-_~<hash16> (24 chars)
  agent-🚀 -> agent-_~<hash16> (24 chars)
  agent-中文 -> agent-__~<hash16> (25 chars)
distinct count: 3 / 3
new Headers(): OK
```

**Observed result:** Distinct Unicode agent ids remain distinct after sanitize; sanitized values are printable ASCII; `new Headers()` succeeds without ByteString `TypeError`; CR/LF values remain omitted.
**Not tested:** Live ClawRouter upstream acceptance/display of the sanitized ids (no ClawRouter credentials in this environment); operator-supplied explicit headers remain unsanitized by design.

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
